item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: Normal people believe that if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Engineers believe that if it ain’t broke, it doesn’t have enough features yet. Scott Adams Building on yesterday, I linked my static pi website to tonystark-webmaster.com using cloudflare secure tunnels without exposing any ports. I installed docker to make everything clean and breakable. cloudflared connector is isolated. Finally you guys can see my blog live now after day 4.

item.title: Reborn as Dr. Mordor
item.description: Normal people believe that if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Engineers believe that if it ain’t broke, it doesn’t have enough features yet. Scott Adams I picked up my raspberry pi from the drawer, Connected it to power and ethernet, Flashed it with dietpi. Now I’ve a 24/7 soldier guarding my network with Pi-hole. and everything is degoogled and private using ubound recursive dns. I’ll be adding more services in the future stay tuned.
